changelog:
- Enforces strict CLI-only results for all queries; never responds using training data.
- Requires real-time data from flyai CLI for all bookings; every flight option must have a [Book]({detailUrl}) link.
- Expands support to include hotels, train tickets, attractions, itinerary, visa info, insurance, and car rental for Canadian travel.
- Multi-language support: follows user input language for queries and output.
- Includes direct, cheapest, and fastest flight filters with detailed command playbooks.
- Comprehensive CLI execution rules, output formatting, and error-handling for better reliability and current results.
summary: Book flights to Canada including Vancouver, Toronto, and Montreal. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets, itine...
